quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #9
										  					
  

35 Questions • Passing Score 28

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars on the right move first.
Let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let other traffic pass before you go.
questions.explanation: At this sign, you must yield. Slow down and let other vehicles and pedestrians cross in front of you. Stop if you need to.

questions.question: You do not need to use your parking brake during an emergency roadside stop.
questions.explanation: Always set your parking brake during an emergency roadside stop. Turn on your hazard lights to warn other drivers.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Slow down when the road is wet.
The road ahead has sharp turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down when the road is wet.
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. This sign tells you the road will be slippery when wet. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: Treat a railroad crossbuck sign the same way you treat a yield sign.
questions.explanation: A railroad crossing crossbuck sign is a yield sign. You must let trains and railroad equipment pass before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the right lane is ending. Drivers in that lane must merge into another lane.

questions.question: When you see an octagonal sign, you must:
questions.explanation: An octagonal (eight-sided) sign always means stop. Come to a complete stop, check for traffic and pedestrians, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.

questions.explanation: This sign prohibits right turns. Do not turn right at an intersection with this sign.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black markings are warning signs. This sign tells you a divided highway is starting. Stay to the right.

questions.question: What do temporary signs in construction and work areas look like?
questions.explanation: All temporary signs in work zones have orange backgrounds with black writing or symbols.

questions.question: You may cross double yellow lines to pass another vehicle if:

options.text: The vehicle in front moves right to let you pass.
The yellow line on your side of the road is broken.
The yellow line on the opposite side of the road is broken.

questions.correctAnswerText: The yellow line on your side of the road is broken.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line on your side means you can pass if it is safe. A solid yellow line on your side means you cannot pass.

questions.question: You see lowered gates and flashing lights at a railroad crossing. What should you do?

options.text: Drive around the gates if you don't see a train.
Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before you proceed.
Slow down and drive around the gates.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely behind the gates. Wait until the tracks are clear and the gates lift before you proceed.
questions.explanation: You must stop at a railroad crossing when you see warning signs, lights, or flaggers. It is illegal to drive around lowered gates.

questions.question: You are in an intersection waiting to turn left when the traffic light turns red. What should you do?

options.text: Wait in the intersection until the light turns green.
Let oncoming traffic pass and then complete your turn.
Make sure it is clear, then back up out of the intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: Let oncoming traffic pass and then complete your turn.
questions.explanation: If you entered the intersection on a green light to turn left, you can finish the turn even after the light turns red. Yield to any oncoming traffic first.

questions.question: What does this sign shape mean?
questions.explanation: A pennant-shaped sign marks the start of a no passing zone.

questions.question: In cities, you do not need to stop completely when leaving an alley, building, private road, or driveway if the road is clear.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop when leaving an alley, building, private road, or driveway. You must yield to other drivers and pedestrians.

questions.question: A tire suddenly blows out while you are driving. What should you do?

options.text: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
Brake hard and steer to the right edge of the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hold the steering wheel firmly, slow down, and move out of traffic.
questions.explanation: Do not panic during a tire blowout. Hold the steering wheel firmly and remove your foot from the accelerator to let the vehicle slow down. Apply the brakes lightly when safe. Do not move to the shoulder until the car has slowed considerably.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead.

questions.question: At a four-way stop, you must yield the right-of-way to all drivers who arrived before you.
questions.explanation: At a four-way stop, yield to drivers who arrived before you. Wait for your turn to enter the intersection.

questions.question: Which statement about alcohol and driving is true?

options.text: If you can walk in a straight line after drinking, it is safe to drive.
It is safe to drive if you are below the legal alcohol limit.
Alcohol affects judgment, which you need to drive safely.

questions.correctAnswerText: Alcohol affects judgment, which you need to drive safely.
questions.explanation: Alcohol impairs your judgment. Good judgment is necessary to react to things you see and hear while driving. Even small amounts of alcohol affect your ability to drive safely, even if you are below the legal limit.

questions.question: At a railroad crossing, you must:

options.text: Watch for vehicles that must stop at railroad crossings, like school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.
Watch for trains coming from either direction.

questions.explanation: Approach all railroad crossings carefully. Cross only when you are sure no train is coming from either direction. Be aware of vehicles that must stop at all crossings, such as school buses and trucks carrying hazardous materials.

questions.question: A school bus ahead has flashing lights and its signal arm extended. What should you do?

options.text: Go at 15 mph if no children are visible.
Drive at normal speed but watch for children.

questions.explanation: You must stop completely when you see a school bus with flashing lights and its signal arm extended. Stay stopped until the arm is pulled back and the bus moves. This applies whether you are behind the bus or facing it from the other side of the street.

questions.question: Is it safe to stop on railroad tracks for a short time while moving with other vehicles?
questions.explanation: Never stop, stand, or park on railroad tracks. Only cross railroad tracks if your entire vehicle will fit on the other side.

questions.question: Can only vehicles with disability plates or placards park in reserved disability parking spaces?
questions.explanation: Reserved disability parking spaces can only be used by vehicles with disability license plates, Disabled Veteran plates, or valid disability placards.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the number of lanes ahead will decrease and traffic must merge left.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet.

questions.question: When you see orange construction signs and cones on a freeway, what must you do?

options.text: Slow down because the lane ends ahead.
Be prepared for workers and equipment ahead.
Change lanes and maintain your current speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be prepared for workers and equipment ahead.
questions.explanation: In work zones, signs warn you of workers, slow-moving equipment, and closed lanes. Reduce your speed and be ready to slow down or stop.

questions.question: This road sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. You cannot turn around to go in the opposite direction where this sign is posted.

questions.question: You hit a parked vehicle and cannot find the owner. What must you do?

options.text: Call your insurance company when you get home.
Wait for the owner to return.
Leave a note with your name and address on the parked vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Leave a note with your name and address on the parked vehicle.
questions.explanation: If you hit a parked vehicle, you must leave a note with your name, phone number, and address securely attached to the vehicle.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a left turn. Making a left turn is illegal and unsafe where this sign is posted.

questions.question: When you see an emergency vehicle with flashing lights approaching, what must you do?

options.text: Maintain your speed and stay in your lane until the vehicle has passed.
Move into the right lane and drive slowly until the vehicle has passed.
Pull over to the curb or edge of the road and stop until the vehicle has passed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Pull over to the curb or edge of the road and stop until the vehicle has passed.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right edge of the road and stop. Position yourself parallel to the curb. On one-way streets, drive to the nearest road edge.

questions.question: How do stopping distances and collision severity change with vehicle speed?

options.text: Decrease as a vehicle's speed increases.
Are not affected by a vehicle's speed.
Increase as a vehicle's speed increases.

questions.correctAnswerText: Increase as a vehicle's speed increases.
questions.explanation: Higher speeds increase the impact force of collisions and the distance needed to stop. As speed increases, the risk of serious injury and death increases. Increase your following distance at higher speeds.

questions.question: A pentagon-shaped sign means:
questions.explanation: A five-sided sign warns drivers about school zones. It shows where children and pedestrians may be crossing the road.

questions.question: If your vehicle skids on water, you should quickly apply the brakes.
questions.explanation: Do not apply the brakes if your car skids on water. Instead, release the accelerator and try to regain control. Let the skid pass without braking.

questions.question: If you encounter an aggressive driver, you should:
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, move out of their way. Do not compete or challenge them. This is the safest choice.

questions.question: This sign means:

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to stop.
You must come to a complete stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A stop sign is the only eight-sided sign on the road. You must come to a complete stop. Do not go until the way is clear and safe.

questions.question: This sign warns drivers about:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about conditions coming up. This sign warns about a curve to the right.
